# The Gap at Dawn

*Mhairi's first verse is the gap at dawn, but she plays too late to ever see one. Look at the gap from the head of the Long Stair, then ask Bethoc what she remembers of the race send-offs.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |

| Level | 22 |

## Objectives

1. Reach the head of the Long Stair in [Gull Heath](../maps/gull_heath.md)
2. Talk to [Bethoc](../npcs/bethoc_innkeeper.md)

## Rewards

- 1,150 EXP
- 450 mesos
- [Gap Inn Stew](../items/gap_inn_stew.md) x2
- +15 standing with Goa Harbour
- +150 standing with [Mhairi](../npcs/mhairi_fiddler.md)
